Mateo: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke + profiling pass for nebula-6.7b (float16 + 4-bit-qat) on staging-dedicated? Target: 512 token average, 1 req/s steady, and a 10k token burst test. Need p50/p95/p99, memory, and a few perf flamegraphs. If possible, use the bench harness flags below and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/bench/nebula-6.7b/

Mateo: ```./bench/run_harness --model nebula-6.7b --dtype fp16 --quant 4qat --profile --seq=512 --rps=1 --burst=10000 --outdir=artifacts/nebula-6.7b```

Jia: I can run the smoke tonight on staging. Any preferred seed/prompts?

Mateo: non-deterministic synthetic prompts ok. prioritize realistic length distribution; see /configs/length_dist.json

Priya: FYI 4-bit-qat config should use qscale=0.98 to avoid quality regressions we saw on heron-8b. Also include kv-cache hit metrics.

Linus: Ran a quick warmup on dev box — p99 latency looks +18% vs best-known 6.1b. Suspect attention kernel fallback on seq=512. Will profile kernel selection.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging cluster 'staging-dedicated' has available capacity (gpu-pool-3). Reserved for bench window 1805125200-1805128800.

Evan: tagging #benchroom and creating bench ticket. PRs for quant knobs: https://git.internal/rw/bench/pull/312 :eyes:

Claire: I can take the burst test this afternoon on dedicated. Will upload flamegraphs + perf counters to the s3 path.

Sam: Shared the initial run logs from my local run in case it's useful:
Sam: ```[info] model load time: 6.3s
[info] p50: 89ms p95: 210ms p99: 350ms
[mem] gpu0 9.4GB / 40GB
[kv-cache] hit_rate: 0.72```

Priya: Interesting p99 is similar to linus' delta. If attention kernel fallback, we should check cuda-malloc fragmentation + kernel selector logs: /var/log/serving/kernel_selector.log

Mateo: Great. Plan: Jia smoke -> Claire burst -> Linus kernel profiling. Everyone drop artifacts to s3 and paste links here. Sam if you can, re-run with qscale=0.98 and attach token-level eval if available. :thumbsup:

Sam: Will do, running now. ETA ~45m

Jia: Smoke finished, uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/nebula-6.7b/smoke/1805125000/. p99=360ms. Link: https://s3.redwood-ci/bench/nebula-6.7b/smoke/1805125000/ :rocket:

Mateo: Received. Thanks all — I'll collate into bench ticket and ping product if there are regressions.
